title: And from his mother how to bring thoughts into the world
html_source: Stephen is placing himself between the view of Plato (that art accesses universal truths which exist outwith us) and the purely material influences of his matter. He steers between the two philosophies by arguing for the nurture based upbringing of Shakespeare. Shakespeare’s genius has primarily been forged by interaction with his human environment.
